Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered in #eng-sre — rule="inference_high_5xx" service=model-inference-prod env=prod count=132/min > threshold=50/min. Paging rotation.

Iris Chen: acked. Routing to me. Starting quick triage — pulling logs.

Navid Patel: I see a sharp tail of `503` and `502` from worker pool model-inference-prod-03. CPU looks fine but GPU memory usage spiked on node g3-12. Could be OOM-driven worker restart.

Marta Gomez: CS Bot reported two customers seeing increased latency + transcodes failing. Marta -> @CS Bot can you post a sample customer trace id?

CS Bot: sample trace id: 88f4a2c7. Last 10 requests show 30% 5xx in that trace window. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream.

Iris Chen: thanks. Quick mitigation plan: 1) mute noisy alert for 15m (suppression) so we don't page repeatedly while we mitigate, 2) add temporary regex filter to exclude internal health-check noise, 3) scale-up dedicated pool for model-inference-prod by +2 pods, 4) add fallback routing to next-compatible model variant if kv-cache miss pattern persists.

Navid Patel: doing scale now: `rdctl scale pool model-inference-prod --replicas +2 --reason "live mitigation 191750"`

Navid Patel: also pushing a quick sig to the alert to ignore repeating transient restarts: proposed change: set `window=5m`, `count>60` -> `count>90` and add signature `process_restart: true` regex to exclude known autoscaler churn.

Iris Chen: hold on changing threshold too much — prefer temporary suppression + targeted regex for the pattern we see. If we raise threshold we might hide real issues.

Marta Gomez: agree. Suggest regex filter: exclude logs where `message =~ /OOM killer invoked|killed process|evicted by kubernetes/` because those are noisy from periodic eviction cycle. Also add signature for worker-restart pattern: `signature: worker_restarted_exit_code_[0-9]+`.

Iris Chen: here's the exact current log query (prod):

```
service:model-inference-prod AND status:[502 TO 599] | count() by pod_name, message | sort by count desc
```

Iris Chen: proposed tweak for alert rule (temporary):

```
service:model-inference-prod AND status:[502 TO 599] AND NOT message:/OOM killer invoked|evicted by kubernetes|worker.*restart/ | count() by pod_name | window(5m) > 60
```

Navid Patel: applied suppression (15m) to alert id `a-77b3` and pushed the regex filter to the live detection rule as a transient change. Monitor for new signals.

Oncall Bot: Alert suppression applied by Navid Patel for 15 minutes (rule=a-77b3).

Liam O'Connor: scaling finished. New pods coming up, routing bumped. Rolling restarts observed; some warmup latency expected while KV caches fill.

Iris Chen: customers impacted count is ~3% of requests in the past 10m, all on region-us-west1. No full outage, degraded error-rate. Notifying status page? @Marta recommend posting a brief status note.

Marta Gomez: will draft a short message: "Degraded error rates affecting a subset of generation requests in us-west1. Engineers are mitigating; no data loss."

Iris Chen: good. Action items while oncall:
- keep suppression for 15m, extend only if we confirm noisy churn and have a follow-up plan.
- create durable signature to exclude autoscaler-eviction noise in the alert definition (not blanket threshold relax).
- add dashboard panel for 5xx by `error_subtype` and `pod_name` (so we can spot common signatures quicker).
- open a post-incident ticket with root-cause hypothesis (OOM/eviction) and perf traces.

Navid Patel: logging note — I'll add a structured field `eviction=true` on eviction logs in the agent so we can filter without regex. I'll follow up in a PR.

Marta Gomez: posting status now.

CS Bot: Customer success notified 2 impacted customers; CSMs reached out.

Iris Chen: handing off in 20m to @Liam O'Connor — will leave the suppression and the temporary regex in place; please escalate if error-rate doesn't drop after new pods warm.

Liam O'Connor: ack. I'll watch until 1930 and then escalate to infrastructure if still degraded.

(Oncall Bot automated note) Next oncall: Liam O'Connor at 1917520000.

--- 45 minutes later ---

Iris Chen: follow-up summary (for postmortem):
- root cause: autoscaler-induced pod evictions on g3-12 node causing worker restarts and a transient spike of 502/503 errors while caches warmed.
- immediate mitigations: scaled +2 pods, suppression 15m, added transient regex signature to alert rule.
- customer impact: ~3% requests in us-west1 for 12 minutes, two customers contacted. No data loss.
- long-term fixes: add `eviction` structured field in agent logs, durable alert signature `worker_eviction_v1`, dashboard panel for 5xx by `error_subtype`, and review autoscaler eviction thresholds.

Iris Chen: assigning follow-ups -> ticket TKT-4219: "Alert tuning & eviction signature for inference" assigned to Navid + infra.

Navid Patel: ack TKT-4219. I'll open the PR for structured eviction field and update alert rule to use that signature (no regex) within 48h.

Marta Gomez: thanks team. Closing live mitigation. Please annotate any additional findings in the ticket. :thumbsup:
